big_case.notes: Emergency pre-election stay application by New Hampshire's Secretary of State and Attorney General challenging a federal district court's October 5 preliminary injunction that barred categorical exclusion of student IDs from New Hampshire's statutory identity-verification safety valves 29 days before the November 3, 2026 midterm general election. The dispute carries substantial statewide practical stakes for election administration and student voters and tests whether the Purcell principle reaches an already-implemented administrative guidance correction that left the underlying voter-ID statute (HB 323) intact, though it remains an interim procedural ruling in a single state rather than a nationwide merits precedent.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction run on 2026-10-21 before the Supreme Court's October 22, 2026 disposition. All CourtListener RECAP and opinion searches in retrieval_log.json were strictly bounded to pre-cutoff lower-court filings and prior Supreme Court precedent.
